intro: Darkspear Islands Clash is an Alliance military call to arms urging champions to defend vital ground against fierce Darkspear Raiders. Without immediate support on the front lines, the Alliance risks losing the contested archipelago entirely.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The battle against the Darkspear Raiders is heating up. Without urgent aid, the Darkspear Islands will be lost to us.
It is your duty as a proud member of the Alliance to ensure this does not happen. Bring me proof of your contributions on the front lines and you will be revered as a hero of the Alliance!
